candidates.statement: The Compton amplitude subtraction function, S1ðQ2Þ, is a critical component in the theoretical determination of the proton-neutron mass difference, and a necessary quantity for the calculation of the proton charge radius.

candidates.statement: In this paper, we determine the Compton amplitude subtraction function over the range 1 ≲Q2 ≲16 GeV2 at the standard subtraction point using the Feynman- Hellmann technique, which has previously been used to determine the structure function moments for the forward [28–30] and off-forward [31,32] Compton amplitudes.
